milestone: Call-target completion before missing closing parentheses
implementation: Add a completion-only EOF parenthesis repair path when the existing end-cursor path is unavailable
Append at most eight temporary closing parentheses while preserving every original suffix and argument
Require the located probe to be a parsed call NameExpr or FieldExpr member before querying checker completion
Keep existing argument/signature recovery boundaries, source budgets, receiver checks, prefix edits and diagnostic publications unchanged

Record call-member completion requires a checked receiver
Argument names with suffixes after the caret retain the earlier strict recovery boundary
Malformed arguments, unclosed arrays/records, mismatches, other lexical errors, later unparsable statements and more than eight missing parentheses fail closed
Prior semantic errors still suppress recovered call targets
Imported aliases and live dependency overlays participate without file writes
Protocol application changes only the name and preserves actual L005 diagnostics and absent hover until real closure
Closing the actual call checks argument types against current dependency declarations
Installed VS Code applies the identifier-only edit, retains the delimiter diagnostic, then checks and hovers the explicitly closed call
